propositions: A plan's source-code reference inventory must be detected when enumerated by hand or demonstrably incomplete rather than derived from the symbol graph
The coaching move directs re-derivation using find_referencing_symbols and string-literal sweeps (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) that the LSP cannot resolve
The criterion must route to plan_review only because project.* criterion ids cannot enter code-review's closed applies_when vocabulary and would create dead moves
The criterion posture must be advisory (default_posture: advisory, no blocking_enabled key) since it coaches method rather than correctness
Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven (code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry reads .rebar/code_review_moves.json), so no engine wiring is required

Detection is demonstrated live with criterion firing at validity 1.0 on incomplete inventories; coaching move applicability is proven deterministically in tests but LLM coach selection controls final offering
